test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

All shirts are pants.

Some pants are tie.

Conclusions:

(I) At least some pants are shirts.

(II) Some shirts are tie.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible venn diagram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbd0b2716f1073b16259437892e7c4d00f5797c1adcd0bf837e3174980695c05.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) At least some pants are shirts → **True**(As, All shirts are pants, so At least some pants are shirts is definitly true)

(II) Some shirts are tie → False(As, there is no direct relation between shirts and tie)

Thus, **Only conclusion I follows**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
